# Zero Block Hero

A stunning hero intro section to introduce key value propositions and guide users towards key action paths.

## Properties

- **Headline Title (`title`)**: Main landing page headline.
- **Description Copy (`lead`)**: Introductory lead paragraph text.
- **Visual Image URL (`image`)**: Media asset URL for side-by-side splits.
- **Primary Button Label (`ctaPrimaryText`)**: Main action button text.
- **Primary Redirect URL (`ctaPrimaryUrl`)**: Target destination link.
- **Secondary Button Label (`ctaSecondaryText`)**: Secondary action button text.
- **Secondary Redirect URL (`ctaSecondaryUrl`)**: Target destination link.
- **Layout Variant (`layout`)**:
  - `layout-1`: Centered Copy (No side images)
  - `layout-2`: Split Left-Text (Text on the left, image on the right)
  - `layout-3`: Split Right-Text (Text on the right, image on the left)
- **Theme Mode (`themeStyle`)**: `light` / `dark` / `gradient`
